description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Masters Division at the 2017 World Championships, pairing the new Golisopod-GX with Garbodor in both its Trashalanche and Garbotoxin versions. Float Stone, Guzma and Acerola keep switching Golisopod-GX into the Active Spot for First Impression, 120 damage for one Grass Energy, and once the opponent has played enough Item cards, Garbodor's Trashalanche finishes the game. The 2017 World Championships were held at the Anaheim Convention Center in Anaheim, California, from 18 to 20 August 2017.

Pokémon sold it as a 2017 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
